anomalies.description: A man in a brown sweater is engaged in a physical struggle with a uniformed officer; the man raises his arm defensively while being restrained, and motion blur indicates active grappling.

Overhead and eye-level shots show multiple individuals on the floor in close physical contact, with one person in a tan jacket pinning or grappling another; a baton lies nearby, indicating a violent scuffle.

A man in a brown jacket is physically engaged in a struggle with another man, lifting and throwing him; a third man in dark clothing assists in restraining the victim.; A man in a dark suit grabs and lifts another man (in brown sweater) by the collar/neck area in an aggressive manner; the victim’s head is tilted back, indicating forceful restraint or assault.; Overhead view shows three individuals on the floor in entangled positions, consistent with ongoing physical combat or takedown; one person appears to be subdued while others are actively engaged.
A man in a dark suit is seen smiling while forcefully grabbing and choking another man (in brown jacket), who appears subdued and unable to resist.
Multiple individuals are on the floor in disarray—some lying motionless, others grappling—indicating a chaotic group confrontation or collapse following violent action.

A man in a brown jacket is shown aiming a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the posture and framing strongly indicate an imminent or ongoing shot.; A man in a brown jacket aims a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash or bullet impact is not visible, but the weapon is clearly pointed and held in firing stance.

A large group of people in a bank lobby are in active disarray: some crouching behind counters, others moving erratically, one person being dragged, and multiple individuals holding objects (e.g., flags, bottles) amid visible chaos—consistent with a violent takeover or riot.
The same man in the brown jacket is seen holding a handgun in a two-handed firing stance, aimed forward, with visible tension and focus consistent with active shooting.

A man in a brown sweater is seen from behind aiming a handgun at two silhouetted figures visible through a glass-paneled door; subsequent frames show him maintaining aim and firing, with muzzle flash implied by lighting changes and posture.

The man in the brown jacket is again shown from behind, aiming a handgun toward two silhouetted figures in a doorway; the gun is raised and aligned, indicating active targeting/shooting.; A man in a brown jacket is seen from behind aiming a handgun toward a glass-paneled door; the posture and weapon orientation strongly indicate an active shooting event.; After the shooting sequence, multiple individuals are shown lying motionless on the floor, including the shooter and others, indicating they have been shot and incapacitated.

In the same chaotic scene, at least one individual is lying prone while others are positioned over them in a manner suggesting non-consensual force or subjugation, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.
Multiple individuals are engaged in physical struggle on the floor near blue stanchion ropes; one person appears to be restraining or grappling another while others are involved in close contact.

A man in a brown sweater and a man in a dark suit engage in physical combat on a staircase; the man in the suit grabs and lifts the other man, who is holding a red bag, and throws him down the stairs.

After being thrown, the man in the dark suit lies motionless on the stairs while the other man continues descending, suggesting the victim is helpless and the attack may be ongoing or recently concluded.
